truth_boundary: Syntax explanation of an independently reviewed allowlist. Stored strings, status labels and references are never mathematical proofs or Lean dependency evidence.
review_basis: Bounded independent schema and construction audit; main reviewed the reader, Core schemas, unknown-expression rejection and exact-source checks. Only unused audit fields were removed. CRLF/LF checkout differences alone are normalized for portable source identity. Independent review found line-ended source truncation could pass the prefix check; each allowlisted body is now bound to an explicit digest of the complete current ASTIS parser excerpt, with a truncation regression test. This is source identity, not proof certification.
